name: FreeSolv experimental hydration free energy

experimental_hydration_free_energy.instruction: Predict the experimental hydration free energy in water for the molecule represented by the SMILES.
experimental_hydration_free_energy.field_description: smiles: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES; no target-derived properties or experimental uncertainty are input.

field_descriptions.smiles: RDKit canonical isomeric SMILES; no target-derived properties or experimental uncertainty are input.

split_policy: Unassigned. Use scaffold groups for held-out chemical families; the 320-member acyclic group makes folds highly imbalanced. Do not claim a balanced scaffold benchmark.
missing_policy: No labels are imputed. Only complete supported structures and finite observed source labels are emitted.
precision_policy: Candidate keeps parsed source numbers. Release formatter caps all numeric values at 12 significant digits.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.evidence: README.md License section and LICENSE at the frozen source commit.
license.caveat: Upstream authors license their rights under CC BY 4.0; any original third-party licensing restrictions remain applicable.

quality_findings: 642 finite experimental labels; no molecular identity duplicates after RDKit canonicalization.
Calculated free energy and all uncertainty/reference fields are excluded from input.
Uncertainty values are preserved only as provenance; source defaults are explicitly flagged.
Scaffold grouping is conservative: all acyclic compounds form one large group, and chirality is ignored for grouping.
source_citation: Mobley DL and Guthrie JP. FreeSolv: a database of experimental and calculated hydration free energies, with input files. J Comput Aided Mol Des (2014). https://doi.org/10.1007/s10822-014-9747-x
grouping_rule: RDKit Bemis-Murcko scaffold without chirality; all acyclic molecules share the empty-scaffold group. Canonical isomeric SMILES identify molecules.
deduplication_rule: Same task, normalized input, normalized label AND official split; preserve all source_refs. Across-split copies retained and flagged, same-input dependencies unioned. Different labels retained.
sample_id_rule: sha256([task_id,input_hash,label,split]) first 24 hex; official split included to preserve split occurrences.
